condition: When a Parquet file has INT96 timestamps inside a Map column and the schema asks for pl.Map(..., pl.Datetime("us")), the map values are still decoded at nanosecond precision, so any timestamp outside the nanosecond range saturates to 2262-04-11.
workaround: Declare the column as pl.List(pl.Struct({"key": ..., "value": pl.Datetime("us")})) instead of pl.Map in the schema.
